scope: Generate bounded, rejectable parameter-family modulation proposals from an already committed delayed association candidate without eligibility modulation or parameter writes.

inputs.association: one assigned Stage-3B-2 historical event reference
inputs.current_facts: current post-commit continuous objective fact vector
inputs.historical_facts: objective fact vector stored with the assigned historical event
inputs.graph_control: reserved coordinates in the current graph-produced continuous token

token_controls.fact_projection: twenty-one graph-produced weights over current-minus-historical objective facts
token_controls.target_projection: six graph-produced weights over generic parameter families
token_controls.association_similarity: all request, fact-projection and target-projection coordinates are excluded

proposal_math.fact_signal: normalized dot product between graph-produced fact weights and normalized current-minus-historical fact contrast
proposal_math.target_vector: fact signal multiplied by normalized graph-produced parameter-family weights

not_persisted: specific node or edge target IDs

compatibility.v0113_checkpoint: upgrade creates empty modulation-proposal metadata without fabricating proposals
compatibility.clone_checkpoint_compaction: committed proposal metadata is copied exactly
compatibility.death: proposal metadata is cleared with the row

forbidden: treating any objective coordinate as engine-defined positive or negative value
using association similarity or delay as credit strength
binding a proposal to concrete graph slots in Stage 3B-3
writing node, edge, retained-state or topology parameters
claiming a proposal as learning, causal attribution or subjecthood
